full: Volkswagen's 1959 campaign put a tiny car above two words. Think small. Instead of pretending the car was bigger, it made smallness the point. White space, plain words, and a modest photo stood out when most cars were bigger and flashier. The lesson is not to copy that layout. Find a real trade-off your product makes, then show why the right customer might prefer it. A limitation can become a reason to choose.
